curvegen.tooltip.help1: Right-click: add point (works at long range)
curvegen.tooltip.help2: Left-click: undo point · Sneak + right-click: options
curvegen.msg.no_target: No block in range to pick
curvegen.msg.segment_done: Segment finished (%s total). Next click: end point of the next segment
curvegen.msg.no_permission: Direct placement needs creative mode or operator permissions. Export a schematic instead.
curvegen.msg.nothing_to_place: Nothing to place: add at least two points first.
curvegen.msg.nothing_to_export: Nothing to export: add at least two points first.
curvegen.msg.too_many: Plan has %s blocks; direct placement is limited to %s.
curvegen.msg.placed: Placed %s blocks (%s skipped in unloaded chunks). Use 'Undo placement' to revert.
curvegen.msg.items_returned: %s items from replaced blocks were put in your inventory.
curvegen.msg.items_discarded: %s items from replaced blocks were discarded (creative).
curvegen.msg.not_curve_schematic: The held schematic was not exported by Curve Gen (no stored position).
curvegen.msg.no_schematic_held: Hold a Create schematic to deploy it.
curvegen.msg.deployed: Schematic %s deployed at %s. Put it in a Schematicannon!
curvegen.msg.exported: Exported %s (%s blocks, anchor %s) to the schematics folder.
curvegen.msg.exported_howto: Write it onto an empty schematic at a Schematic Table. It deploys at the right position automatically as soon as you hold it.
curvegen.cmd.out_of_world: That position is outside the world.
curvegen.msg.point_ignored: Point ignored: same block as the path end, or the point limit was reached.
curvegen.msg.containers: %s containers with items were paved over; their contents come back with 'Undo placement'.
curvegen.msg.export_large: The schematic is %s KB. Create's upload limit defaults to 256 KB; raise it in Create's server config or split the road.
curvegen.hud.title: Curve Planner
curvegen.hud.help: RMB add point · LMB undo · Sneak+RMB / V: options
curvegen.gui.title: Curve Planner
curvegen.gui.heading: Heading: %s
curvegen.gui.align_tip: Snaps the direction of travel at this end to the nearest of N/E/S/W, so a straight built by hand lines up.
curvegen.gui.finish_tip: Splines keep taking points until you finish them.
curvegen.gui.lane_hint: Lanes run left → right across the road (in the direction you draw it).
curvegen.gui.picker.title: Pick a block
